_doc: Question activities in the town (story 9.2, services/activityLogic.js, entities/Activities.js, ui/screens/ActivityScreen.js). Each activity is a list of `stages`; a stage asks `n` choice questions of a learning `topic` restricted to the sub-tag `tag` through the learning engine (so every answer is recorded in the kid's learning stats, context `bakery`). pfand: the recycling machine in the market district, a kid counts what the bottles earn (money questions). bakery: ordering and paying at the bakery counter (reached from the bakery shop screen); the kid chooses to order in German (article questions) or in English (vocabulary questions, rewarded `englishMultiplier` times better), then pays (money questions). Rewards: `perCorrectCents` for every right answer (rounded to 5 cents), `allCorrectCents` more when everything was right, and `xpPerCorrect` xp for the kid; `perDay` limits how often one kid can play it a game day (flag activity.<id>.<day>.<player>). Texts: activity.*
